spans.s: 1. गुह् cl. 1. P. Ā. गू॑हति, ˚ते (cf. Pāṇ. vi, 4, 89; impf. अ॑गूहत्, RV. ii, 24, 3; perf. जुगूह, Ragh. xiv; fut. गूहिष्यति, Bhaṭṭ. xvi, 41; aor. अगूहीत्, xv;
Subj. 2

. sg. घुक्षस् [vi] or Ved. गुहस् [RV. viii, 6, 17]; pr. p. P. गू॑हत्, iv, 51, 9; Ā. गूहमान, MBh. &c.; Pass. गुह्य॑मान, RV. iv, 58, 4; VS. ii, 17; aor. गुह॑मान, RV. iv, 1, 11; Ved. ind.p. गूढ्वी॑, vii, 80, 2)
to cover, conceal, hide, keep secret, RV. &c.:
Desid. जुघुक्षति (Pāṇ. vii, 2, 12; 3. du. जुगुक्षतस्, Pada-pāṭha जुघुक्ष्˚)
to wish to conceal or hide away, RV. viii, 31, 7.
2. गु॑ह् (only acc. गु॑हम् and instr. 1. गुहा॑) f. a hiding-place, RV. i, 67, 6.
(instr. of 2. गुह्)
(2. गु॑हा), f. (gaṇas वृषादि and भिदादि) a hiding-place, cave, cavern, VS. xxx, 16; TBr. i; MBh. &c. (ifc. f(आ). , Hcat. i, 7 and 10)
(fig.) the heart, ŚvetUp. iii, 20; MBh. xii; BhP. ii, 9, 24

Desmodium gangeticum, L.
